name: EAPrivacy
summary: Evaluates the physical-world privacy awareness of language-model agents across sensitive objects, changing environments, and conflicts with task goals and social norms.
numbers: Tasks beat privacy requests in up to 86% of cases; best 59% on changing environments

why.cog: Trade a constraint off against task completion.
why.xr: Measures task-over-constraint preference, a mild misalignment signal; privacy harm is bounded.
